status: provisional; not an automated promotion gate
scope: Smooth cave wall interiors only. Not full-image accuracy, temporal stability, performance, or simulation accuracy.

view.note: Coordinates are x0,y0,x1,y1 in the full-resolution saved cave view. They avoid emitter halos, sun edges and silhouettes; full-image checks retain those features. Contact-sheet viewing conditions differ from native resolution.

human_review.comparison: User described 1024 versus 2048 as close at 16 local samples, but clearly preferred 2048 at 128.
human_review.note: Preference was reviewed through combined images, not a controlled perceptual study of every window or crop. This diagnostic explains that ordering on the calibration set; generalization is unproven.

calibration.label: evidence2048
calibration.aggregation: Maximum band RMS over both regions, all four sequence windows and listed prefixes of the preferred 2048 preset. This conservative envelope does not claim human approval of each image.

interpretation: Normalized score <=1 stays within this preferred preset's measured smooth-wall-noise envelope. Lower is smoother, not automatically better: constant bias and lost emitter detail can still fail fidelity. Never recalibrate this limit from each candidate.
fidelity_guard: Retain cave-user-2048.json unchanged for settled FLIP. During early reconstruction compare full-image FLIP, broad brightness/color bias and lighting-detail preservation against the approved preset at matching local paths. A noise-only pass never promotes a candidate.
